descriptions.w3d_mesh_descriptor_bind_animation: Appears to swap a mesh descriptor's clip library for a fresh one and re-register the previous clip under a fixed name.
descriptions.w3d_fn_801803f0: Returns the constant 1; likely a class capability flag for the mesh type.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_descriptor_get_clip: Reports a fatal error if the clip library is missing, then fetches and returns a clip object from it.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_filter_accepts: Checks an object's run-time class against several mesh classes selected by instance flags; returns 1 when it matches.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_target_reset_shared: Points a target's shared reference at a global object, releasing the old one, and clears an active flag.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_construct: Constructs a mesh instance: base and member setup, clears its four references and flags, and counts live instances.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_destruct: Destroys a mesh instance: releases its four references, destroys members and base, and decrements the live count.
descriptions.w3d_fn_801809c0: Returns the constant 1; likely a class capability flag for the mesh instance type.
